newsitem.title: UK: Dlr/mark ends higher in Europe,helped by slower M3.
newsitem.headline: Dlr/mark ends higher in Europe,helped by slower M3.

text.p: The dollar ended firmer above 1.55 marks in Europe, buoyed by a slowdown in German money supply growth in November, traders said.

M3 money supply growth eased to an annualised 8.0 percent from 8.4 in October, arousing vague expectations that the Bundesbank might ease credit on Thursday at its last council meeting of the year. The market expected an average rise of 8.1.

Few in the market expect a rate cut but analysts said the Bundesbank may have a window of opportunity to shave rates as it often fixes the repo rate over the year-end holiday period and may do so at a slightly lower rate than the current 3.0 percent.
